champions.name: Ahri
champions.tldr: Mana cost reduced to 55–95 from 60–100.; AP ratio per hit increased to 45% AP from 40% AP.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: K'Sante slams his tonfa down in the target direction that deals 50–150 (+ 40% AD) (+ 30% bonus armor) (+ 30% bonus magic resistance) physical damage to enemies hit and slow them by 80% for 0.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If this hits at least one enemy, K'Sante generates a stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next Ntofo Strikes consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Empowered Active: K'Sante fires a shockwave in the target direction that applies the same effects to enemies hit, but also airborne them towards him over 1 second and stun them for the same duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: All Out|All Out Bonus:}} Ntofo Strikes's cooldown is by 1 second and it no longer slow targets hit.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Ntofo Strikes partially basic attack reset K'Sante's basic attack timer. While All Out}}, it fully resets the timer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Path Maker can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. Path Maker's charge cannot be interrupt by crowd control.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: K'Sante dash in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing 4.25–5.25% of target's maximum health physical damage to enemies he passes through, airborne them alongside him, and stun them for 0.35–0.75 seconds. When charged, the damage goes up to 8.25–9.25% of target's maximum health and the stun goes up to 0.85–1.25 seconds. This damage is capped at 50–475 against monsters.

lines.label: Change

Upon going All Out, Path Maker's cooldown is refreshed. When charged, this bonus damage goes up to 110–350 (+ 50% AD).
